chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Isma'il ibn Sahl, from Abdullah ibn Jundab, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Say: O Allah, make me fear You as if I can see You, and make me happy with Your piety, and do not make me miserable by my eagerness to disobey You, and choose for me in Your decree, and bless me in Your ordainment, until I do not love the delay of what You hasten nor the hastening of what You delay; and make my self-sufficiency within myself, and grant me enjoyment with my hearing and my sight, and make them the inheritors from me, and help me against those who oppress me, and show me Your power in them, O Lord, and make my eyes delighted with that.
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for achieving the state of seeing God in prayer?
ai.summary: This supplication, recorded in al-Kafi, encapsulates the Shia spiritual ideal of 'ihsan' (worshipping Allah as if you see Him), linking inner reverence with practical contentment in divine decree (qada' and qadar). It emphasizes the preservation of one's faculties as a trust for the Hereafter and seeks divine empowerment over oppressors, reflecting the balance between personal piety and social justice in Imami theology.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ismail Bin Sahl, from Abdullah Bin Jundab, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

Say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Make me to fear You<sup>azwj</sup> as if I can see You<sup>azwj</sup>, and Assist me with being pious to You<sup>azwj</sup>, and do not Cause me to be miserable by my practicing to disobeying You<sup>azwj</sup>, and Choose for me in Your<sup>azwj</sup> Judgment, and Bless for me in Your<sup>azwj</sup> Ordainment until I do not love the delay of what You<sup>azwj</sup> Hasten nor hastening of what You<sup>azwj</sup> Delay; and Make self-sufficiency in myself, and Cause me to enjoy with my hearing and my vision, and Make them both as the inheritors from me, and Help me against the ones who oppress me, and Show me Your<sup>azwj</sup> Power in it, O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and my eyes to be delighted with that’’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Isma’Il ibn Sahl from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jundab from his father from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Say, ‘O Lord, make me fear You as if I see You and help me to be pious before You, do not make me miserable because of my energy to disobey You, chose me for Your determination, bless me with Your measure so I will not love the delay of that which You have hastened and the quickening of what You have delayed. Make me self reliant, benefit me from my hearing, and eyes and make them inherent in me, support me against those who have done injustice to me, and show me Your power in it, O Lord, and make it a delight to my eyes.”’
